H1.definition: a primitive word; father, in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application chief, (fore-) father(-less), × patrimony, principal. Compare names in 'Abi-'.

H3.definition: from the same as 24; a green plant greenness, fruit.

H5.definition: of foreign origin; Abagtha, a eunuch of Xerxes Abagtha.

H8.definition: active of participle of 6; (concrete) wretched or (abstract) destruction perish.

H9.definition: from 6; Compare 10. concrete, something lost; abstract, destruction, i.e. Hades lost.

H10.definition: the same as 9, miswritten for 11; a perishing destruction.

H11.definition: intensive from 6; abstract, a perishing; concrete, Hades destruction.

H14.definition: a primitive root; to breathe after, i.e. (figuratively) to be acquiescent consent, rest content will, be willing.

H16.definition: from 14 (in the sense of bending toward); the papyrus swift.

H17.definition: from 14 (in the sense of desiring); want sorrow.

H18.definition: from 75; a manger or stall crib.

H19.definition: from an unused root (apparently meaning to turn); brandishing of a sword point.

H20.definition: of uncertain derivation; a melon (only plural) melon.

H21.definition: from 1; fatherly; Abi, Hezekiah's mother Abi.

H22.definition: from 1 and 410; father (i.e. possessor) of God; Abiel, the name of two Israelites Abiel.

H23.definition: from 1 and 622; father of gathering (i.e. gatherer); Abiasaph, an Israelite Abiasaph.

H24.definition: from an unused root (meaning to be tender); green, i.e. a young ear of grain; hence, the name of the month Abib or Nisan Abib, ear, green ears of corn (not maize).

H38.definition: from 1 and 3220; father of (the) sea (i.e. seaman); Abijam (or Abijah), a king of Judah Abijam.

H39.definition: from 1 and an elsewhere unused (probably foreign) word; father of Mael (apparently some Arab tribe); Abimael, a son of Joktan Abimael.

H40.definition: from 1 and 4428; father of (the) king; Abimelek, the name of two Philistine kings and of two Israelites Abimelech.

H41.definition: from 1 and 5068; father of generosity (i.e. liberal); Abinadab, the name of four Israelites Abinadab.

H44.definition: from 1 and 5829; father of help (i.e. helpful); Abiezer, the name of two Israelites Abiezer.

H45.definition: from 1 and an unused root of uncertain derivation; probably, father of strength (i.e. valiant); Abialbon, an Israelite Abialbon.

H47.definition: for 46  angel, bull, chiefest, mighty (one), stout(-hearted), strong (one), valiant.

H48.definition: from 1 and 7311; father of height (i.e. lofty); Abiram, the name of two Israelites Abiram.

H49.definition: from 1 and 7686; father of error (i.e. blundering); Abishag, a concubine of David Abishag.

H63.definition: from 58 and the plural of 7848, with the article inserted; meadow of the acacias; Abel hash-Shittim, a place in Palestine Abelshittim.

H74.definition: or (fully) אֲבִינֵר ; from 1 and 5216; father of light (i.e. enlightening); Abner, an Israelite Abner.

H75.definition: a primitive root; to fodder fatted, stalled.

H76.definition: (by reduplication) from an unused root (meaning to belch forth); an inflammatory pustule (as eruption) blains.

H78.definition: from the same as 76; splendid; Ibtsan, an Israelite Ibzan.

H82.definition: a primitive root; to soar fly.

H85.definition: contracted from 1 and an unused root (probably meaning to be populous); father of a multitude; Abraham, the later name of Abram Abraham.

H87.definition: contracted from 48; high father; Abram, the original name of Abraham Abram.

H88.definition: plural of 178; water-skins; Oboth, a place in the Desert Oboth.

H90.definition: or אֲגָג; of uncertain derivation (compare 89); flame; Agag, a title of Amalekitish kings Agag.

H101.definition: probably from 5059; a bowl (as pounded out hollow) basin, cup, goblet.

H102.definition: probably from 5062 (through the idea of impending); a cover or heap; i.e. (only plural) wings of an army, or crowds of troops bands.

H103.definition: a primitive root; to harvest gather.

H104.definition: (Aramaic) of Persian origin; an epistle (as carried by a state courier or postman) letter.

H105.definition: of uncertain derivation; a basin charger.

H106.definition: from 1640 (in the sense of grasping); the clenched hand fist.

H108.definition: from the same as 181 (in the sense of enveloping); a fog mist, vapor.

H112.definition: of uncertain derivation; Iddo, an Israelite Iddo.

H113.definition: or (shortened) אָדֹן; from an unused root (meaning to rule); sovereign, i.e. controller (human or divine) lord, master, owner. Compare also names beginning with 'Adoni-'.

H114.definition: probably intensive for 113; powerful; Addon, apparently an Israelite Addon.

H115.definition: dual from 142 (in the sense of eminence); double mound; Adorajim, a place in Palestine Adoraim.

H116.definition: (Aramaic) of uncertain derivation; then (of time) now, that time, then.

H117.definition: from 142; wide or (generally) large; figuratively, powerful excellent, famous, gallant, glorious, goodly, lordly, mighty(-ier one), noble, principal, worthy.

H119.definition: to show blood (in the face), i.e. flush or turn rosy be (dyed, made) red (ruddy).

H121.definition: the same as 120; Adam the name of the first man, also of a place in Palestine Adam.

H123.definition: or (fully) אֱדוֹם ; from 122; red (see Genesis 25:25); Edom, the elder twin-brother of Jacob; hence the region (Idumaea) occupied by him Edom, Edomites, Idumea.

H126.definition: contracted for 127; earthy; Admah, a place near the Dead Sea Admah.

H129.definition: from 127; earthy; Adami, a place in Palestine Adami.

H130.definition: or (fully) אֱדוֹמִי ; patronymic from 123; See 726. an Edomite, or descendants from (or inhabitants of) Edom Edomite.

H131.definition: plural of 121; red spots; Adummim, a pass in Palestine Adummim.

H132.definition: or (fully) אַדְמוֹנִי ; from 119; reddish (of the hair or the complexion) red, ruddy.

H134.definition: from the same as 113 (in the sense of strength); a basis (of a building, a column, etc.) foundation, socket.

H139.definition: from 113 and 6664; lord of justice; Adoni-Tsedek, a Canaanitish king Adonizedec.

H140.definition: from 113 and 6965; lord of rising (i.e. high); Adonikam, the name of one or two Israelites Adonikam.

H141.definition: from 113 and 7311; lord of height; Adoniram, an Israelite Adoniram.

H142.definition: a primitive root; to expand, i.e. be great or (figuratively) magnificent (become) glorious, honourable.

H143.definition: probably of foreign derivation; perhaps meaning fire; Adar, the 12th Hebrew month Adar.

H145.definition: from 142; amplitude, i.e. (concrete) a mantle; also (figuratively) splendor goodly, robe.

H146.definition: intensive from 142; ample; Addar, a place in Palestine; also an Israelite Addar.

H147.definition: (Aramaic) intensive, from a root corresponding to 142; ample, i.e. a threshing-floor threshingfloor.

H148.definition: (Aramaic) from the same as 147, and 1505; a chief diviner, or astrologer judge.

H149.definition: (Aramaic) probably of Persian origin; quickly or carefully diligently.

H150.definition: of Persian origin; a daric or Persian coin dram.

H151.definition: contracted for 141; Adoram (or Adoniram), an Israelite Adoram.

H152.definition: from 142 and 4428; splendor of (the) king; Adrammelek, the name of an Assyrian idol, also of a son of Sennacherib Adrammelech.

H153.definition: (Aramaic) an orthographical variation for 1872; an arm, i.e. (figuratively) power force.

H154.definition: from the equivalent of 153; mighty; Edrei, the name of two places in Palestine Edrei.

H155.definition: feminine of 117; ; also the same as 145 something ample (as a large vine, a wide dress) garment, glory, goodly, mantle, robe.

H156.definition: a primitive root; to tread out (grain) thresh.

H157.definition: or אָהֵב ; a primitive root; to have affection for (sexually or otherwise) (be-) love(-d, -ly, -r), like, friend.

H158.definition: from 157; affection (in a good or a bad sense) love(-r).

H159.definition: from 156; meaning the same as 158  love.

H160.definition: feminine of 158 and meaning the same  love.

H161.definition: from an unused root meaning to be united; unity; Ohad, an Israelite Ohad.

H162.definition: apparently a primitive word expressing pain exclamatorily; Oh! ah, alas.

H163.definition: probably of foreign origin; Ahava, a river of Babylonia Ahava.

H164.definition: from the same as 161; united; Ehud, the name of two or three Israelites Ehud.

H166.definition: a primitive root; to be clear shine.

H175.definition: of uncertain derivation; Aharon, the brother of Moses Aaron.

H180.definition: or (shortened) אֻבָל ; from 2986 (in the sense of 2988); a stream river.

H184.definition: a primitive root; to extend or mark out point out.

H187.definition: of uncertain derivation; Uzal, a son of Joktan Uzal.

H189.definition: probably from 183; desirous; Evi, a Midianitish chief Evi.

H191.definition: from an unused root (meaning to be perverse); (figuratively) silly fool(-ish) (man).

H200.definition: from the same as 191; silliness folly, foolishly(-ness).

H201.definition: from 559; talkative; Omar, a grandson of Esau Omar.

H204.definition: or (shortened); אֹן; of Egyptian derivation; On, a city of Egypt On.

H2711.definition: from 2710; an enactment, a resolution decree, thought.

H2712.definition: or (fully) חוּקֹק; from 2710; appointed; Chukkok or Chukok, a place in Palestine Hukkok, Hukok.

H2714.definition: from 2713; examination, enumeration, deliberation finding out, number, (un-) search(-able, -ed, out, -ing).

H2715.definition: or (fully) חוֹר; from 2787; (compare 2751) properly, white or pure (from the cleansing or shining power of fire); hence (figuratively) noble (in rank) noble.

H2716.definition: from an unused (and vulgar) root probably meaning to evacuate the bowels; excrement dung. Also חֲרִי.

H2718.definition: (Aramaic) a root corresponding to 2717; to demolish destroy.

H2719.definition: from 2717; drought; also a cutting instrument (from its destructive effect), as a knife, sword, or other sharp implement axe, dagger, knife, mattock, sword, tool.

H2720.definition: from 2717; parched or ruined desolate, dry, waste.

H2722.definition: from 2717; desolate; Choreb, a (generic) name for the Sinaitic mountains Horeb.

H2728.definition: from 2727; the leaping insect, i.e. a locust beetle.

H2730.definition: from 2729; fearful; also reverential afraid, trembling.

H2731.definition: feminine of 2730; fear, anxiety care, × exceedingly, fear, quaking, trembling.

H2733.definition: patrial from a derivative of 2729 (compare 5878); a Charodite, or inhabitant of Charod Harodite.

H2735.definition: from 2356 and a collateral (masculine) form of 1412, with the article interposed; hole of the cleft; Chor-hag-Gidgad, a place in the Desert Hor-hagidgad.

H2736.definition: ; from 2734 and 3050; fearing Jah; Charhajah, an Israelite Harhaiah.

H2737.definition: from an unused root meaning to perforate; properly, pierced, i.e. a bead of pearl, gems or jewels (as strung) chain.

H2738.definition: or (shortened) חָרֻל; apparently, a passive participle of an unused root probably meaning to be prickly; properly, pointed, i.e. a bramble or other thorny weed nettle.

H2739.definition: from passive participle of 2763 and 639; snub-nosed; Charumaph, an Israelite Harumaph.

H2740.definition: or (shortened) חָרֹן; from 2734; a burning of anger sore displeasure, fierce(-ness), fury, (fierce) wrath(-ful).

H2741.definition: a patrial from (probably) a collateral form of 2756; a Charuphite or inhabitant of Charuph (or Chariph) Haruphite.

H2744.definition: a fuller form of 2746; inflammation; Charchur, one of the Nethinim Harhur.

H2745.definition: from the same as 2775; perhaps shining; Charchas, an Israelite Harhas.

H2750.definition: from 2734; a burning (i.e. intense) anger fierce, × great, heat.

H2751.definition: from the same as 2353; white bread white.

H2752.definition: from 2356; cave-dweller or troglodyte; a Chorite or aboriginal Idumaean Horims, Horites.

H2753.definition: or חוֹרִי; the same as 2752; Chori, the name of two men Hori.

H2755.definition: from the plural of 2716 and the plural of 3123; or perhaps rather the plural of a single word חֲרָאיוֹן, probably a kind of vegetable excrements of doves doves' dung.

H2756.definition: from 2778; autumnal; Chariph, the name of two Israelites Hariph.

H2757.definition: or חֲרִץ; from 2782; (compare 2742) properly, incisure or (passively) incised; hence, a threshing-sledge (with sharp teeth); also a slice (as cut) cheese, harrow.

H2759.definition: from 2790 in the sense of silence; quiet, i.e. sultry (as feminine noun, the sirocco or hot east wind) vehement.

H2760.definition: a primitive root; to braid (i.e. to entangle or snare) or catch (game) in a net roast.

H2774.definition: of uncertain derivation; Charnepher, an Israelite Harnepher.

H2776.definition: the same as 2775; shining; Cheres, a mountain in Palestine Heres.

H2777.definition: from 2775 (apparently in the sense of a red tile used for scraping); a potsherd, i.e. (by implication) a pottery; the name of a gate at Jerusalem east.

H2778.definition: a primitive root; also denominative (from 2779) to pull off, i.e. (by implication) to expose (as by stripping); specifically, to betroth (as if a surrender); figuratively, to carp at, i.e. defame; to spend the winter betroth, blaspheme, defy, jeopard, rail, reproach, upbraid.

H2779.definition: from 2778; properly, the crop gathered, i.e. (by implication) the autumn (and winter) season; figuratively, ripeness of age cold, winter (-house), youth.

H2780.definition: from 2778; reproachful; Chareph, an Israelite Hareph.

H2781.definition: from 2778; contumely, disgrace, the pudenda rebuke, reproach(-fully), shame.

H2784.definition: of uncertain derivation; a fetter; figuratively, a pain band.

H2801.definition: a primitive root; to engrave graven.

H2802.definition: from 2801 (but equivalent to 2793); forest; Chereth, a thicket in Palestine Hereth.

H2813.definition: from 2808 and 3050; thought of Jah; Chashabnejah, the name of two Israelites Hashabniah.

H2815.definition: from 2803; intelligent; Chashshub, the name of two or three Israelites Hashub, Hasshub.

H2828.definition: from the same as 2831; enriched; Chashum, the name of two or three Israelites Hashum.

H2832.definition: feminine of 2831; fertile; Chasmonah, a place in the Desert Hashmonah.

H2842.definition: by variation for 7179; dry grass chaff.

H3591.definition: from the same as 3589; (perhaps smaller than 2595) properly, something to strike with, i.e. a dart lance, shield, spear, target.

H3592.definition: the same as 3591; Kidon, a place in Palestine Chidon.

H3593.definition: of uncertain derivation; perhaps tumult battle.

H3594.definition: from 3559; properly, a statue, i.e. idol; but used (by euphemism) for some heathen deity (perhaps corresponding to Priapus or Baal-peor) Chiun.

H3595.definition: or כִּיֹּר; from the same as 3564; properly, something round (as excavated or bored), i.e. a chafing-dish for coals or a caldron for cooking; hence (from similarity of form) a washbowl; also (for the same reason) a pulpit or platform hearth, laver, pan, scaffold.

H3596.definition: or כֵּלַי; from 3557 in the sense of withholding; niggardly churl.

H3597.definition: from an unused root meaning to clap or strike with noise; a club or sledge-hammer hammer.

H3598.definition: from the same as 3558; a cluster of stars, i.e. the Pleiades Pleiades, seven stars.

H3599.definition: a form for 3563; a cup; also a bag for money or weights bag, cup, purse.

H3600.definition: a form for 3564 (only in the dual); a cooking range (consisting of two parallel stones, across which the boiler is set) ranges for pots.

H3601.definition: from 3787; compare 6418 literally a director, i.e. the spindle or shank of a distaff, by which it is twirled spindle.

H3602.definition: from 3541; just so, referring to the previous or following context after that (this) manner, this matter, (even) so, in such a case, thus.

H3603.definition: from 3769; a circle, i.e. (by implication) a circumjacent tract or region, especially the Ghor or valley of the Jordan; also a (round) loaf; also a talent (or large [round] coin) loaf, morsel, piece, plain, talent.

H3605.definition: or (Jeremiah 33:8) כּוֹל; from 3634; properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense) (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

H3606.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to 3605  all, any, (forasmuch) as, be-(for this) cause, every, no (manner, -ne), there (where) -fore, though, what (where, who) -soever, (the) whole.

H3607.definition: a primitive root; to restrict, by act (hold back or in) or word (prohibit) finish, forbid, keep (back), refrain, restrain, retain, shut up, be stayed, withhold.

H3609.definition: apparently from 3607 and 1; restraint of (his) father; Kilab, an Israelite Chileab.

H3610.definition: dual of 3608 in the original sense of separation; two heterogeneities divers seeds (-e kinds), mingled (seed).

H3611.definition: from an unused root means. to yelp, or else to attack; a dog; hence (by euphemism) a male prostitute dog.

H3612.definition: perhaps a form of 3611, or else from the same root in the sense of forcible; Caleb, the name of three Israelites Caleb.

H3613.definition: from 3612 and 672; Caleb-Ephrathah, a place in Egypt (if the text is correct) Caleb-ephrathah.

H3614.definition: probably by erroneous transcription for כָּלֵבִי; patronymically from 3612; a Calebite or descendant of Caleb of the house of Caleb.

H3615.definition: a primitive root; to end, whether intransitive (to cease, be finished, perish) or transitive (to complete, prepare, consume) accomplish, cease, consume (away), determine, destroy (utterly), be (when... were) done, (be an) end (of), expire, (cause to) fail, faint, finish, fulfil, × fully, × have, leave (off), long, bring to pass, wholly reap, make clean riddance, spend, quite take away, waste.

H3617.definition: from 3615; a completion; adverb, completely; also destruction altogether, (be, utterly) consume(-d), consummation(-ption), was determined, (full, utter) end, riddance.

H3618.definition: from 3634; a bride (as if perfect); hence, a son's wife bride, daughter-in-law, spouse.

H3619.definition: from the same as 3611; a bird-trap (as furnished with a clap-stick or treadle to spring it); hence, a basket (as resembling a wicker cage) basket, cage.

H3620.definition: the same as 3619; Kelub, the name of two Israelites Chelub.

H3621.definition: a form of 3612; Kelubai, an Israelite Chelubai.

H3622.definition: from 3615; completed; Keluhai, an Israelite Chelluh.

H3623.definition: denominative passive participle from 3618; bridehood (only in the plural) espousal.

H3624.definition: from an unused root meaning to be complete; maturity full (old) age.

H3625.definition: the same as 3624; Kelach, a place in Assyria Calah.

H3626.definition: from 3605 and 2374; every seer; Col-Chozeh, an Israelite Col-hozeh.

H3627.definition: from 3615; something prepared, i.e. any apparatus (as an implement, utensil, dress, vessel or weapon) armour(-bearer), artillery, bag, carriage, furnish, furniture, instrument, jewel, that is made of, × one from another, that which pertaineth, pot, psaltery, sack, stuff, thing, tool, vessel, ware, weapon, whatsoever.

H3628.definition: or כְּלוּא; from 3627 (compare 3608); a prison prison.

H3629.definition: feminine of 3627 (only in the plural); a kidney (as an essential organ); figuratively, the mind (as the interior self) kidneys, reins.

H3630.definition: a form of 3631; Kiljon, an Israelite Chilion.

H3632.definition: from 3634; complete; as noun, the whole (specifically, a sacrifice entirely consumed); as adverb, fully all, every whit, flame, perfect(-ion), utterly, whole burnt offering (sacrifice), wholly.

H3633.definition: from 3557; sustenance; Calcol, an Israelite Calcol, Chalcol.

H3634.definition: a primitive root; to complete (make) perfect.

H3635.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to 3634; to complete finish, make (set) up.

H3636.definition: from 3634; complete; Kelal, an Israelite Chelal.

H3637.definition: a primitive root; properly, to wound; but only figuratively, to taunt or insult be (make) ashamed, blush, be confounded, be put to confusion, hurt, reproach, (do, put to) shame.

H3638.definition: of foreign derivation; Kilmad, a place apparently in the Assyrian empire Chilmad.

H3639.definition: from 3637; disgrace confusion, dishonour, reproach, shame.

H3641.definition: or כַּלְנֵה; also כַּלְנוֹ; of foreign derivation; Calneh or Calno, a place in the Assyrian empire Calneh, Calno. Compare 3656.

H3642.definition: a primitive root; to pine after long.

H3643.definition: from 3642; pining; Kimham, an Israelite Chimham.

H3644.definition: or כָּמוֹ; a form of the prefix k, but used separately [compare 3651]; as, thus, so according to, (such) as (it were, well as), in comparison of, like (as, to, unto), thus, when, worth.

H3645.definition: or (Jeremiah 48:7) כְּמִישׁ; from an unused root meaning to subdue; the powerful; Kemosh, the god of the Moabites Chemosh.

H3646.definition: from an unused root meaning to store up or preserve; 'cummin' (from its use as a condiment) cummin.

H3647.definition: a primitive root; to store away, i.e. (figuratively) in the memory lay up in store.

H3648.definition: a primitive root; properly, to intertwine or contract, i.e. (by implication) to shrivel (as with heat); figuratively, to be deeply affected with passion (love or pity) be black, be kindled, yearn.

H3649.definition: from 3648; properly, an ascetic (as if shrunk with self-maceration), i.e. an idolatrous priest (only in plural) Chemarims (idolatrous) priests.

H3650.definition: redupl. from 3648; obscuration (as if from shrinkage of light), i.e. an eclipse (only in plural) blackness.

H3651.definition: from 3559; properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles) after that (this, -ward, -wards), as... as, (for-) asmuch as yet, be (for which) cause, following, howbeit, in (the) like (manner, -wise), × the more, right, (even) so, state, straightway, such (thing), surely, there (where) -fore, this, thus, true, well, × you.

H3653.definition: the same as 3651, used as a noun; a stand, i.e. pedestal or station base, estate, foot, office, place, well.

H3654.definition: from 3661 in the sense of fastening; (from infixing its sting; used only in plural (and irregular in Exodus 8:17,18; Hebrews 13:14)) a gnat lice, × manner.

H3655.definition: a primitive root; to address by an additional name; hence, to eulogize give flattering titles, surname (himself).

H3656.definition: for 3641; Canneh, a place in Assyria Canneh.

H3658.definition: from a unused root meaning to twang; a harp harp.

H3659.definition: for 3204; Conjah, an Israelite king Coniah.

H3660.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to 3644; so or thus so, (in) this manner (sort), thus.

H3661.definition: a primitive root; to set out, i.e. plant × vineyard.

H3662.definition: from 3661; planted; Kenani, an Israelite Chenani.

H3663.definition: or כְּנַנְיָהוּ; from 3661 and 3050; Jah has planted; Kenanjah, an Israelite Chenaniah.

H3664.definition: a primitive root; to collect; hence, to enfold gather (together), heap up, wrap self.

H3665.definition: a primitive root; properly, to bend the knee; hence, to humiliate, vanquish bring down (low), into subjection, under, humble (self), subdue.

H3666.definition: from 3665 in the sense of folding (compare 3664); a package wares.

H3667.definition: from 3665; humiliated; Kenaan, a son a Ham; also the country inhabited by him Canaan, merchant, traffick.

H3668.definition: feminine of 3667; Kenaanah, the name of two Israelites Chenaanah.

H3669.definition: patrial from 3667; a Kenaanite or inhabitant of Kenaan; by implication, a pedlar (the Canaanites standing for their neighbors the Ishmaelites, who conducted mercantile caravans) Canaanite, merchant, trafficker.

H3670.definition: a primitive root; properly, to project laterally, i.e. probably (reflexive) to withdraw be removed.

H3671.definition: from 3670; an edge or extremity; specifically (of a bird or army) a wing, (of a garment or bedclothing) a flap, (of the earth) a quarter, (of a building) a pinnacle bird, border, corner, end, feather(-ed), × flying, (one an-) other, overspreading, × quarters, skirt, × sort, uttermost part, wing(-ed).

H3672.definition: or כִּנֶּרֶתlemma כִּנֶרֶת missing dagesh, corrected to כִּנֶּרֶת; respectively plural and singular feminine from the same as 3658; perhaps harp-shaped; Kinneroth or Kinnereth, a place in Palestine Chinnereth, Chinneroth, Cinneroth.

H3673.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to 3664; to assemble gather together.

H3674.definition: from 3655; a colleague (as having the same title) companion.

H3676.definition: apparently a contraction for 3678, but probably by erroneous transcription for 5251  sworn.

H3677.definition: or כֶּסֶה; apparently from 3680; properly, fulness or the full moon, i.e. its festival (time) appointed.

H3678.definition: or כִּסֵּה; from 3680; properly, covered, i.e. a throne (as canopied) seat, stool, throne.

H3680.definition: a primitive root; properly, to plump, i.e. fill up hollows; by implication, to cover (for clothing or secrecy) clad self, close, clothe, conceal, cover (self), (flee to) hide, overwhelm. Compare 3780.

H3681.definition: passive participle of 3680; properly, covered, i.e. (as noun) a covering covering.

H3682.definition: from 3680; a cover (garment); figuratively, a veiling covering, raiment, vesture.

H3683.definition: a primitive root; to cut off cut down (up).

H3684.definition: from 3688; properly, fat, i.e. (figuratively) stupid or silly fool(-ish).

H3685.definition: the same as 3684; any notable constellation; specifically Orion (as if a burly one) constellation, Orion.

H3686.definition: the same as 3684; Kesil, a place in Palestine Chesil.

H3688.definition: a primitive root; properly, to be fat, i.e. (figuratively) silly be foolish.

H3689.definition: from 3688; properly, fatness, i.e. by implication (literally) the loin (as the seat of the leaf fat) or (generally) the viscera; also (figuratively) silliness or (in a good sense) trust confidence, flank, folly, hope, loin.

H3690.definition: feminine of 3689; in a good sense, trust; in a bad one, silliness confidence, folly.

H3691.definition: probably of foreign origin; Kisleu, the 9th Hebrew month Chisleu.

H3692.definition: from 3688; hopeful; Kislon, an Israelite Chislon.

H3693.definition: from 3688; fertile; Kesalon, a place in Palestine Chesalon.

H3694.definition: feminine plural of passive participle of 3688; fattened; Kesulloth, a place in Palestine Chesulloth.

H3695.definition: a plural probably of foreign derivation; Casluchim, a people cognate to the Egyptians Casluhim.

H3696.definition: from the feminine plural of 3689 and 8396; flanks of Tabor; Kisloth-Tabor, a place in Palestine Chisloth-tabor.

H3697.definition: a primitive root; to shear × only, poll. Compare 3765.

H3698.definition: from 3697; spelt (from its bristliness as if just shorn) fitches, rie.

H3699.definition: a primitive root; to estimate make count.

H3700.definition: a primitive root; properly, to become pale, i.e. (by implication) to pine after; also to fear (have) desire, be greedy, long, sore.

H3701.definition: from 3700; silver (from its pale color); by implication, money money, price, silver(-ling).

H3703.definition: perhaps from 3701; silvery; Casiphja, a place in Babylon Casiphia.

H3704.definition: from 3680; a cushion or pillow (as covering a seat or bed) pillow.

H3706.definition: (Aramaic) or כְּעֶת; (Aramaic), feminine of 3705; thus (only in the formula 'and so forth') at such a time.

H3707.definition: a primitive root; to trouble; by implication, to grieve, rage, be indignant be angry, be grieved, take indignation, provoke (to anger, unto wrath), have sorrow, vex, be wroth.

H3708.definition: or (in Job) כַּעַשׂ; from 3707; vexation anger, angry, grief, indignation, provocation, provoking, × sore, sorrow, spite, wrath.

H3709.definition: from 3721; the hollow hand or palm (so of the paw of an animal, of the sole, and even of the bowl of a dish or sling, the handle of a bolt, the leaves of a palm-tree); figuratively, power branch, foot, hand((-ful), -dle, (-led)), hollow, middle, palm, paw, power, sole, spoon.

H3711.definition: a primitive root; properly, to bend, i.e. (figuratively) to tame or subdue pacify.

H3712.definition: feminine of 3709; a leaf of a palmtree branch.

H3713.definition: from 3722; properly, a cover, i.e. (by implication) a tankard (or covered goblet); also white frost (as covering the ground) bason, hoar(-y) frost.

H3714.definition: from an unused root meaning to connect; a girder beam.

H3715.definition: from 3722; a village (as covered in by walls); also a young lion (perhaps as covered with a mane) (young) lion, village. Compare 3723.

H3716.definition: feminine of 3715; the village (always with the art.); Kephirah, a place in Palestine Chephirah.

H3717.definition: a primitive root; to fold together; figuratively, to repeat double.

H3719.definition: a primitive root; to bend bend.

H3720.definition: from 3719; hunger (as making to stoop with emptiness and pain) famine.

H3721.definition: a primitive root; to curve bow down (self).

H3722.definition: a primitive root; to cover (specifically with bitumen); figuratively, to expiate or condone, to placate or cancel appease, make (an atonement, cleanse, disannul, forgive, be merciful, pacify, pardon, purge (away), put off, (make) reconcile(-liation).

H3723.definition: from 3722; a village (as protected by walls) village. Compare 3715.

H3724.definition: from 3722; properly, a cover, i.e. (literally) a village (as covered in); (specifically) bitumen (as used for coating), and the henna plant (as used for dyeing); figuratively, a redemption-price bribe, camphire, pitch, ransom, satisfaction, sum of money, village.

H3726.definition: from 3723 and 5984, with the article interposed; village of the Ammonite; Kefar-ha-Ammoni, a place in Palestine Chefarhaamonai.

H3727.definition: from 3722; a lid (used only of the cover of the sacred Ark) mercy seat.

H3728.definition: a primitive root; to tread down; figuratively, to humiliate cover.

H3729.definition: (Aramaic) a root of uncertain correspondence; to fetter bind.

H3730.definition: or (Amos 9:1) כַּפְתּוֹר; probably from an unused root meaning to encircle; a chaplet; but used only in an architectonic sense, i.e. the capital of a column, or a wreath-like button or disk on the candelabrum knop, (upper) lintel.

H3731.definition: or (Amos 9:7) כַּפְתּוֹר; apparently the same as 3730; Caphtor (i.e. a wreath-shaped island), the original seat of the Philistines Caphtor.

H3732.definition: patrial from 3731; a Caphtorite (collectively) or native of Caphtor Caphthorim, Caphtorim(-s).

H3733.definition: from 3769 in the sense of plumpness; a ram (as full-grown and fat), including a battering-ram (as butting); hence, a meadow (as for sheep); also a pad or camel's saddle (as puffed out) captain, furniture, lamb, (large) pasture, ram. See also 1033, 3746.

H3734.definition: from the same as 3564; properly, a deep round vessel, i.e. (specifically) a cor or measure for things dry cor, measure. Aramaic the same.

H3735.definition: (Aramaic) probably corresponding to 3738 in the sense of piercing(figuratively); to grieve be grieved.

H3736.definition: from the same as 3525; to gird or clothe clothed.

H3737.definition: (Aramaic) from a verb corresponding to that of 3736; a mantle hat.

H3738.definition: a primitive root; properly, to dig; figuratively, to plot; generally, to bore or open dig, × make (a banquet), open.

H3739.definition: usually assigned as a primitive root, but probably only a special application of 3738 (through the common idea of planning implied in a bargain); to purchase buy, prepare.

H3742.definition: of uncertain derivation; a cherub or imaginary figure cherub, (plural) cherubims.

H3743.definition: the same as 3742; Kerub, a place in Babylon Cherub.

H3745.definition: (Aramaic) probably of Greek origin; to proclaim make a proclamation.

H3746.definition: perhaps an abridged plural of 3733 in the sense of leader (of the flock); a life-guardsman captains, Cherethites (from the margin).

H3747.definition: from 3772; a cut; Kerith, a brook of Palestine Cherith.

H3748.definition: from 3772; a cutting (of the matrimonial bond), i.e. divorce divorce(-ment).

H3749.definition: expanded from the same as 3522; a rim or top margin compass.

H3750.definition: probably of foreign origin; the crocus saffron.

H3751.definition: of foreign derivation; Karkemish, a place in Syria Carchemish.

H3752.definition: of Persian origin; Karkas, a eunuch of Xerxes Carcas.

H3753.definition: from 3769; a dromedary (from its rapid motion as if dancing) swift beast.

H3754.definition: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a garden or vineyard vines, (increase of the) vineyard(-s), vintage. See also 1021.

H3755.definition: active participle of an imaginary denominative from 3754; a vinedresser vine dresser (as one or two words).

H3756.definition: from 3754; gardener; Karmi, the name of three Israelites Carmi.

H3757.definition: patronymically from 3756; a Karmite or descendant of Karmi Carmites.

H3758.definition: probably of foreign origin; carmine, a deep red crimson.

H3759.definition: from 3754; a planted field (garden, orchard, vineyard or park); by implication, garden produce full (green) ears (of corn), fruitful field (place), plentiful (field).

H3760.definition: the same as 3759; Karmel, the name of a hill and of a town in Palestine Carmel, fruitful (plentiful) field, (place).

H3761.definition: patron from 3760; a Karmelite or inhabitant of Karmel (the town) Carmelite.

H3762.definition: feminine of 3761; a Karmelitess or female inhabitant of Karmel Carmelitess.

H3763.definition: of uncertain derivation; Keran, an aboriginal Idumaean Cheran.

H3766.definition: a primitive root; to bend the knee; by implication, to sink, to prostrate bow (down, self), bring down (low), cast down, couch, fall, feeble, kneeling, sink, smite (stoop) down, subdue, × very.

H3767.definition: from 3766; the leg (from the knee to the ankle) of men or locusts (only in the dual) leg.

H3768.definition: of foreign origin; byssus or fine vegetable wool green.

H3769.definition: a primitive root; to dance (i.e. whirl) dance(-ing).

H3770.definition: by variation from 7164; the paunch or belly (as swelling out) belly.

H3771.definition: of foreign origin; Karshena, a courtier of Xerxes Carshena.

H3772.definition: a primitive root; to cut (off, down or asunder); by implication, to destroy or consume; specifically, to covenant (i.e. make an alliance or bargain, originally by cutting flesh and passing between the pieces) be chewed, be con-(feder-) ate, covenant, cut (down, off), destroy, fail, feller, be freed, hew (down), make a league (covenant), × lose, perish, × utterly, × want.

H3773.definition: passive participle feminine of 3772; something cut, i.e. a hewn timber beam.

H3774.definition: probably from 3772 in the sense of executioner; (compare 2876) (only collectively in the singular as plural) a Kerethite or life-guardsman Cherethims, Cherethites.

H3775.definition: apparently by transposition for 3532; a young sheep lamb.

H3776.definition: feminine of 3775; a young ewe lamb.

H3777.definition: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; Kesed, a relative of Abraham Chesed.

H3778.definition: (occasionally with enclitic) כַּשְׂדִּימָה; towards the Kasdites into Chaldea), patronymically from 3777 (only in the plural); a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed; by implication, a Chaldaean (as if so descended); also an astrologer (as if proverbial of that people Chaldeans, Chaldees, inhabitants of Chaldea.

H3779.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to 3778; a Chaldaean or inhabitant of Chaldaea; by implication, a Magian or professional astrologer Chaldean.

H3780.definition: a primitive root; to grow fat (i.e. be covered with flesh) be covered. Compare 3680.

H3781.definition: from 3782; properly, a feller, i.e. an axe ax.

H3782.definition: a primitive root; to totter or waver (through weakness of the legs, especially the ankle); by implication, to falter, stumble, faint or fall bereave (from the margin), cast down, be decayed, (cause to) fail, (cause, make to) fall (down, -ing), feeble, be (the) ruin(-ed, of), (be) overthrown, (cause to) stumble, × utterly, be weak.

H3783.definition: from 3782; properly, a tottering, i.e. ruin fall.

H3784.definition: a primitive root; properly, to whisper a spell, i.e. to inchant or practise magic sorcerer, (use) witch(-craft).

H3787.definition: a primitive root properly, to be straight or right; by implication, to be acceptable; also to succeed or prosper direct, be right, prosper.

H3788.definition: from 3787; success, advantage equity, good, right.

H3789.definition: a primitive root; to grave, by implication, to write (describe, inscribe, prescribe, subscribe) describe, record, prescribe, subscribe, write(-ing, -ten).

H3791.definition: from 3789; something written, i.e. a writing, record or book register, scripture, writing.

H3793.definition: from 3789; a letter or other mark branded on the skin × any (mark).

H3794.definition: or כִּתִּיִּי; patrial from an unused name denoting Cyprus (only in the plural); a Kittite or Cypriote; hence, an islander in general, i.e. the Greeks or Romans on the shores opposite Palestine Chittim, Kittim.

H3796.definition: from an unused root meaning to compact; a wall (as gathering inmates) wall.

H3798.definition: from 3796 and 376; wall of a man; Kithlish, a place in Palestine Kithlish.

H3799.definition: a primitive root; properly, to carve or engrave, i.e. (by implication) to inscribe indelibly mark.

H3800.definition: from 3799; properly, something carved out, i.e. ore; hence, gold (pure as originally mined) ((most) fine, pure) gold(-en wedge).

H3801.definition: or כֻּתֹּנֶת; from an unused root meaning to cover (compare 3802); a shirt coat, garment, robe.

H3802.definition: from an unused root meaning to clothe; the shoulder (proper, i.e. upper end of the arm; as being the spot where the garments hang); figuratively, side-piece or lateral projection of anything arm, corner, shoulder(-piece), side, undersetter.

H3806.definition: a primitive root; to butt or pound bray.

H3807.definition: a primitive root; to bruise or violently strike beat (down, to pieces), break in pieces, crushed, destroy, discomfit, smite, stamp. l

H5025.definition: from 5024; a bark; Nobach, the name of an Israelite, and of a place East of the Jordan Nobah.

H5026.definition: of foreign origin; Nibchaz, a deity of the Avites Nibhaz.

H5027.definition: a primitive root; to scan, i.e. look intently at; by implication, to regard with pleasure, favor or care (cause to) behold, consider, look (down), regard, have respect, see.

H5028.definition: from 5027; regard; Nebat, the father of Jeroboam I Nebat.

H5030.definition: from 5012; a prophet or (generally) inspired man prophecy, that prophesy, prophet.

H5031.definition: feminine of 5030; a prophetess or (generally) inspired woman; by implication, a poetess; by association a prophet's wife prophetess.

H5032.definition: or נְבָיֹת; feminine plural from 5107; fruitfulnesses; Nebajoth, a son of Ismael, and the country settled by him Nebaioth, Nebajoth.

H5033.definition: from an unused root meaning to burst forth; a fountain spring.

H5034.definition: a primitive root; to wilt; generally, to fall away, fail, faint; figuratively, to be foolish or (morally) wicked; causatively, to despise, disgrace disgrace, dishounour, lightly esteem, fade (away, -ing), fall (down, -ling, off), do foolishly, come to nought, × surely, make vile, wither.

H5035.definition: or נֵבֶל; from 5034; a skin-bag for liquids (from collapsing when empty); hence, a vase (as similar in shape when full); also a lyre (as having a body of like form) bottle, pitcher, psaltery, vessel, viol.

H5036.definition: from 5034; stupid; wicked (especially impious) fool(-ish, -ish man, -ish woman), vile person.

H5037.definition: the same as 5036; dolt; Nabal, an Israelite Nabal.

H5038.definition: from 5034; a flabby thing, i.e. a carcase or carrion (human or bestial, often collectively); figuratively, an idol (dead) body, (dead) carcase, dead of itself, which died, (beast) that (which) dieth of itself.

H5039.definition: feminine of 5036; foolishness, i.e. (morally) wickedness; concretely, a crime; by extension, punishment folly, vile, villany.

H5040.definition: from 5036; properly, disgrace, i.e. the (female) pudenda lewdness.

H5041.definition: apparently from 5036 and 3909; foolish secrecy; Neballat, a place in Palestine Neballat.

H5042.definition: a primitive root; to gush forth; figuratively, to utter (good or bad words); specifically, to emit (a foul odor) belch out, flowing, pour out, send forth, utter (abundantly).

H5043.definition: (Aramaic) from an unused root meaning to shine; a light; plural (collectively) a chandelier candlestick.

H5044.definition: of uncertain derivation; Nibshan, a place in Palestine Nibshan.

H5045.definition: from an unused root meaning to be parched; the south (from its drought); specifically, the Negeb or southern district of Judah, occasionally, Egypt (as south to Palestine) south (country, side, -ward).

H5046.definition: a primitive root; properly, to front, i.e. stand boldly out opposite; by implication (causatively), to manifest; figuratively, to announce (always by word of mouth to one present); specifically, to expose, predict, explain, praise bewray, × certainly, certify, declare(-ing), denounce, expound, × fully, messenger, plainly, profess, rehearse, report, shew (forth), speak, × surely, tell, utter.

H5047.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to 5046; to flow (through the idea of clearing the way) issue.

H5048.definition: from 5046; a front, i.e. part opposite; specifically a counterpart, or mate; usually (adverbial, especially with preposition) over against or before about, (over) against, × aloof, × far (off), × from, over, presence, × other side, sight, × to view.

H5050.definition: a primitive root; to glitter; causatively, to illuminate (en-) lighten, (cause to) shine.

H5051.definition: from 5050; brilliancy (literally or figuratively) bright(-ness), light, (clear) shining.

H5052.definition: the same as 5051; Nogah, a son of David Nogah.

H5055.definition: a primitive root; to butt with the horns; figuratively, to war against gore, push (down, -ing).

H5056.definition: from 5055; butting, i.e. vicious used (wont) to push.

H5057.definition: or נָגִד; from 5046; a commander (as occupying the front), civil, military or religious; generally (abstractly, plural), honorable themes captain, chief, excellent thing, (chief) governor, leader, noble, prince, (chief) ruler.

H5058.definition: or נְגִינַת; (Psalm 61:title), from 5059; properly, instrumental music; by implication, a stringed instrument; by extension, a poem set to music; specifically, an epigram stringed instrument, musick, Neginoth (plural), song.

H5059.definition: a primitive root; properly, to thrum, i.e. beat a tune with the fingers; expectation. to play on a stringed instrument; hence (generally), to make music player on instruments, sing to the stringed instruments, melody, ministrel, play(-er, -ing).

H5060.definition: a primitive root; properly, to touch, i.e. lay the hand upon (for any purpose; euphemistically, to lie with a woman); by implication, to reach (figuratively, to arrive, acquire); violently, to strike (punish, defeat, destroy, etc.) beat, (× be able to) bring (down), cast, come (nigh), draw near (nigh), get up, happen, join, near, plague, reach (up), smite, strike, touch.

H5061.definition: from 5060; a blow (figuratively, infliction); also (by implication) a spot (concretely, a leprous person or dress) plague, sore, stricken, stripe, stroke, wound.

H5062.definition: a primitive root; to push, gore, defeat, stub (the toe), inflict (a disease) beat, dash, hurt, plague, slay, smite (down), strike, stumble, × surely, put to the worse.

H5063.definition: from 5062; a trip (of the foot); figuratively, an infliction (of disease) plague, stumbling.

H5064.definition: a primitive root; to flow; figuratively, to stretch out; causatively, to pour out or down; figuratively, to deliver over fall, flow away, pour down (out), run, shed, spilt, trickle down.

H5065.definition: a primitive root; to drive (an animal, a workman, a debtor, an army); by implication, to tax, harass, tyrannize distress, driver, exact(-or), oppress(-or), × raiser of taxes, taskmaster.

H5066.definition: a primitive root; to be or come (causatively, bring) near (for any purpose); euphemistically, to lie with a woman; as an enemy, to attack; religious to worship; causatively, to present; figuratively, to adduce an argument; by reversal, to stand back (make to) approach (nigh), bring (forth, hither, near), (cause to) come (hither, near, nigh), give place, go hard (up), (be, draw, go) near (nigh), offer, overtake, present, put, stand.

H5067.definition: from 5110 in the sense of piling up; a mound, i.e. wave heap.

H5068.definition: a primitive root; to impel; hence, to volunteer (as a soldier), to present spontaneously offer freely, be (give, make, offer self) willing(-ly).

H5069.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to 5068; be (or give) liberal(-ly) (be minded of...own) freewill (offering), offer freely (willingly).

H5070.definition: from 5068; liberal; Nadab, the name of four Israelites Nadab.

H5071.definition: from 5068; properly (abstractly) spontaneity, or (adjectively) spontaneous; also (concretely) a spontaneous or (by inference, in plural) abundant gift free(-will) offering, freely, plentiful, voluntary(-ily, offering), willing(-ly), offering).

H5072.definition: from 5068 and 3050; largess of Jah; Nedabjah, an Israelite Nedabiah.

H5073.definition: (Aramaic) from a root meaning to stick; a layer (of building materials) row.

H5074.definition: a primitive root; properly, to wave to and fro (rarely to flap up and down); figuratively, to rove, flee, or (causatively) to drive away chase (away), × could not, depart, flee (× apace, away), (re-) move, thrust away, wander (abroad, -er, -ing).

H5075.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to 5074; to depart go from.

H5076.definition: passive participle of 5074; properly, tossed; abstractly, a rolling (on the bed) tossing to and fro.

H5077.definition: or נָדָא; (2 Kings 17:21), a primitive root; properly, to toss; figuratively, to exclude, i.e. banish, postpone, prohibit cast out, drive, put far away.

H5078.definition: from 5077 in the sense of freely flinging money; a bounty (for prostitution) gifts.

H5079.definition: from 5074; properly, rejection; by implication, impurity, especially personal (menstruation) or moral (idolatry, incest) × far, filthiness, × flowers, menstruous (woman), put apart, × removed (woman), separation, set apart, unclean(-ness, thing, with filthiness).

H5080.definition: a primitive root; to push off; used in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (to expel, mislead, strike, inflict, etc.) banish, bring, cast down (out), chase, compel, draw away, drive (away, out, quite), fetch a stroke, force, go away, outcast, thrust away (out), withdraw.

H5081.definition: from 5068; properly, voluntary, i.e. generous; hence, magnanimous; as noun, a grandee (sometimes a tyrant) free, liberal (things), noble, prince, willing (hearted).

H5082.definition: feminine of 5081; properly, nobility, i.e. reputation soul.

H5083.definition: probably from an unused root meaning to give; a present (for prostitution) gift.

H5084.definition: of uncertain derivation; a sheath (of a sword) sheath.

H5085.definition: (Aramaic) from the same as 5084; a sheath; figuratively, the body (as the receptacle of the soul) body.

H5086.definition: a primitive root; to shove asunder, i.e. disperse drive (away, to and fro), thrust down, shaken, tossed to and fro.

H5087.definition: a primitive root; to promise (pos., to do or give something to God) (make a) vow.

H5088.definition: or נֵדֶר; from 5087; a promise (to God); also (concretely) a thing promised vow(-ed).

H5089.definition: from an unused root meaning to lament; lamentation wailing.

H5090.definition: a primitive root; to drive forth (a person, an animal or chariot), i.e. lead, carry away; reflexively, to proceed (i.e. impel or guide oneself); also (from the panting induced by effort), to sigh acquaint, bring (away), carry away, drive (away), lead (away, forth), (be) guide, lead (away, forth).

H5091.definition: a primitive root; to groan, i.e. bewail; hence (through the idea of crying aloud), to assemble (as if on proclamation) lament, wail.

H5094.definition: (Aramaic) or נְהִירוּ; (Aramaic), from the same as 5105; illumination, i.e. (figuratively) wisdom light.

H5095.definition: a primitive root; properly, to run with a sparkle, i.e. flow; hence (transitively), to conduct, and (by inference) to protect, sustain carry, feed, guide, lead (gently, on).

H5096.definition: or נַהֲלֹל; the same as 5097; Nahalal or Nahalol, a place in Palestine Nahalal, Nahallal, Nahalol.

H5098.definition: a primitive root; to growl mourn, roar(-ing).

H5101.definition: a primitive root; to bray (as an ass), scream (from hunger) bray.

H5102.definition: a primitive root; to sparkle, i.e. (figuratively) be cheerful; hence (from the sheen of a running stream) to flow, i.e. (figuratively) assemble flow (together), be lightened.

H5103.definition: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to 5102; a river, especially the Euphrates river, stream.

H5104.definition: from 5102; a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile, Euphrates, etc.); figuratively, prosperity flood, river.

H5105.definition: from 5102 in its original sense; daylight light.

H5106.definition: a primitive root; to refuse, forbid, dissuade, or neutralize break, disallow, discourage, make of none effect.

H5107.definition: a primitive root; to germinate, i.e. (figuratively) to (causatively, make) flourish; also (of words), to utter bring forth (fruit), make cheerful, increase.

H5108.definition: or נֵיב; from 5107; produce, literally or figuratively fruit.

H5109.definition: from 5108; fruitful; Nobai, an Israelite Nebai (from the margin).

H5110.definition: a primitive root; to nod, i.e. waver; figuratively, to wander, flee, disappear; also (from shaking the head in sympathy), to console, deplore, or (from tossing the head in scorn) taunt bemoan, flee, get, mourn, make to move, take pity, remove, shake, skip for joy, be sorry, vagabond, way, wandering.

H5111.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to 5116; to flee get away.

H5113.definition: the same as 5112; vagrancy; Nod, the land of Cain Nod.

H5114.definition: from 5068; noble; Nodab, an Arab tribe Nodab.

H5115.definition: a primitive root; (compare 5116) to rest (as at home); causatively (through the implied idea of beauty), to celebrate (with praises) keep at home, prepare an habitation.

H5116.definition: or (feminine) נָוָה; from 5115; (adjectively) at home; hence (by implication of satisfaction) lovely; also (noun) a home, of God (temple), men (residence), flocks (pasture), or wild animals (den) comely, dwelling (place), fold, habitation, pleasant place, sheepcote, stable, tarried.

H5117.definition: a primitive root; to rest, i.e. settle down; used in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, intransitive, transitive and causative (to dwell, stay, let fall, place, let alone, withdraw, give comfort, etc.) cease, be confederate, lay, let down, (be) quiet, remain, (cause to, be at, give, have, make to) rest, set down. Compare 3241.

H5118.definition: or נוֹחַ; from 5117; quiet rest(-ed, -ing place).

H5119.definition: feminine of 5118; quietude; Nochah, an Israelite Nohah.

H5121.definition: from 5115; residence; Navith, a place in Palestine Naioth (from the margin).

H5122.definition: (Aramaic) or נְוָלִי; (Aramaic), from an unused root probably meaning to be foul; a sink dunghill.

H5123.definition: a primitive root; to slumber (from drowsiness) sleep, slumber.

H5125.definition: a primitive root; to resprout, i.e. propagate by shoots; figuratively, to be perpetual be continued.

H5126.definition: or נוֹן; (1 Chronicles 7:27), from 5125; perpetuity, Nun or Non, the father of Joshua Non, Nun.

H5127.definition: a primitive root; to flit, i.e. vanish away (subside, escape; causatively, chase, impel, deliver) × abate, away, be displayed, (make to) flee (away, -ing), put to flight, × hide, lift up a standard.

H5128.definition: a primitive root; to waver, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (as subjoined) continually, fugitive, × make, to (go) up and down, be gone away, (be) move(-able, -d), be promoted, reel, remove, scatter, set, shake, sift, stagger, to and fro, be vagabond, wag, (make) wander (up and down).

H5129.definition: from 3259 and 3050; convened of Jah; Noadjah, the name of an Israelite, and a false prophetess Noadiah.

H5130.definition: a primitive root; to quiver (i.e. vibrate up and down, or rock to and fro); used in a great variety of applications (including sprinkling, beckoning, rubbing, bastinadoing, sawing, waving, etc.) lift up, move, offer, perfume, send, shake, sift, strike, wave.

H5132.definition: a primitive root; properly, to flash; also, to fly away (from the quickness of motion) flee away, bud (forth).

H5133.definition: or נֹצָה; feminine active participle of 5327 in the sense of flying; a pinion (or wing feather); often (collectively) plumage feather(-s), ostrich.

H5134.definition: a primitive root; to suckle nurse.

H5135.definition: (Aramaic) from an unused root (corresponding to that of 5216) meaning to shine; fire fiery, fire.

H5136.definition: a primitive root; to be sick, i.e. (figuratively) distressed be full of heaviness.

H5137.definition: a primitive root; to spirt, i.e. besprinkle (especially in expiation) sprinkle.

H5138.definition: from 2102; something boiled, i.e. soup pottage.

H5139.definition: or נָזִר; from 5144; separate, i.e. consecrated (as prince, a Nazirite); hence (figuratively from the latter) an unpruned vine (like an unshorn Nazirite) Nazarite (by a false alliteration with Nazareth), separate(-d), vine undressed.

H5140.definition: a primitive root; to drip, or shed by trickling distil, drop, flood, (cause to) flow(-ing), gush out, melt, pour (down), running water, stream.

H5141.definition: from an unused root of uncertain meaning; a nose-ring earring, jewel.

H5142.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to the root of 5143; to suffer (causatively, inflict) loss have (en-) damage, hurt(-ful).

H5143.definition: from an unused root meaning to injure; loss damage.

H5144.definition: a primitive root; to hold aloof, i.e. (intransitivey) abstain (from food and drink, from impurity, and even from divine worship (i.e. apostatize)); specifically, to set apart (to sacred purposes), i.e. devote consecrate, separate(-ing, self).

H5145.definition: or נֵזֶר; from 5144; properly, something set apart, i.e. (abstractly) dedication (of a priet or Nazirite); hence (concretely) unshorn locks; also (by implication) a chaplet (especially of royalty) consecration, crown, hair, separation.

H5146.definition: the same as 5118; rest; Noach, the patriarch of the flood Noah.

H5147.definition: from 2247; occult; Nachbi, an Israelite Nakbi.

H5148.definition: a primitive root; to guide; by implication, to transport (into exile, or as colonists) bestow, bring, govern, guide, lead (forth), put, straiten.

H5149.definition: from 5162; comforted; Nechum, an Israelite Nehum.

H5150.definition: or נִחֻם; from 5162; properly, consoled; abstractly, solace comfort(-able), repenting.

H5151.definition: from 5162; comfortable; Nachum, an Israelite prophet Nahum.

H5152.definition: from the same as 5170; snorer; Nachor, the name of the grandfather and a brother of Abraham Nahor.

H5153.definition: apparently passive participle of 5172 (perhaps in the sense of ringing), i.e. bell-metal; or from the red color of the throat of a serpent (5175, as denominative) when hissing); coppery, i.e. (figuratively) hard of brass.

H5154.definition: or נְחֻשָׁה; feminine of 5153; copper brass, steel. Compare 5176.

H5155.definition: probably denominative from 2485; a flute (plural) Nehiloth.

H5156.definition: from the same as 5170; a nostril (dual) nostrils.

H5157.definition: a primitive root; to inherit (as a (figurative) mode of descent), or (generally) to occupy; causatively, to bequeath, or (generally) distribute, instate divide, have (inheritance), take as a heritage, (cause to, give to, make to) inherit, (distribute for, divide (for, for an, by), give for, have, leave for, take (for)) inheritance, (have in, cause to, be made to) possess(-ion).

H5158.definition: or (feminine) נַחְלָה; (Psalm 124:4), or נַחֲלָה; (Ezekiel 47:19; Ezekiel 48:28), from 5157 in its original sense; a stream, especially a winter torrent; (by implication) a (narrow) valley (in which a brook runs); also a shaft (of a mine) brook, flood, river, stream, valley.

H5159.definition: from 5157 (in its usual sense); properly, something inherited, i.e. (abstractly) occupancy, or (concretely) an heirloom; generally an estate, patrimony or portion heritage, to inherit, inheritance, possession. Compare 5158.

H5160.definition: from 5158 and 410; valley of God; Nachaliël, a place in the Desert Nahaliel.

H5161.definition: apparently a patronymic from an unused name (apparently passive participle of 2492); dreamed; a Nechelamite, or descendant of Nechlam Nehelamite.

H5162.definition: a primitive root; properly, to sigh, i.e. breathe strongly; by implication, to be sorry, i.e. (in a favorable sense) to pity, console or (reflexively) rue; or (unfavorably) to avenge (oneself) comfort (self), ease (one's self), repent(-er,-ing, self).

H5163.definition: from 5162; consolation; Nacham, an Israelite Naham.

H5166.definition: from 5162 and 3050; consolation of Jah; Nechemjah, the name of three Israelites Nehemiah.

H5167.definition: from 5162; consolatory; Nachamani, an Israelite Nahamani.

H5169.definition: a primitive root; to be urgent require haste.

H5170.definition: and (feminine) נַחֲרָה; from an unused root meaning to snort or snore; a snorting nostrils, snorting.

H5171.definition: or נַחְרַי; from the same as 5170; snorer; Nacharai or Nachrai, an Israelite Naharai, Nahari.

H5172.definition: a primitive root; properly, to hiss, i.e. whisper a (magic) spell; generally, to prognosticate × certainly, divine, enchanter, (use) × enchantment, learn by experience, × indeed, diligently observe.

H5173.definition: from 5172; an incantation or augury enchantment.

H5175.definition: from 5172; a snake (from its hiss) serpent.

H5176.definition: the same as 5175; Nachash, the name of two persons apparently non-Israelite Nahash.

H5177.definition: from 5172; enchanter; Nachshon, an Israelite Naashon, Nahshon.

H5178.definition: for 5154; copper, hence, something made of that metal, i.e. coin, a fetter; figuratively, base (as compared with gold or silver) brasen, brass, chain, copper, fetter (of brass), filthiness, steel.

H5179.definition: from 5178; copper; Nechushta, an Israelitess Nehushta.

H5180.definition: from 5178; something made of copper, i.e. the copper serpent of the Desert Nehushtan.

H5181.definition: a primitive root; to sink, i.e. descend; causatively, to press or lead down be broken, (cause to) come down, enter, go down, press sore, settle, stick fast.

H5182.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to 5181; to descend; causatively, to bring away, deposit, depose carry, come down, depose, lay up, place.

H5183.definition: from 5182; also (intransitively; perhaps from 5117) a descent, i.e. imposition, unfavorable (punishment) or favorable (food); restfulness lighting down, quiet(-ness), to rest, be set on.

H5184.definition: the same as 5183; quiet; Nachath, the name of an Edomite and of two Israelites Nahath.

H5186.definition: a primitive root; to stretch or spread out; by implication, to bend away (including moral deflection); used in a great variety of application (as follows) afternoon, apply, bow (down, -ing), carry aside, decline, deliver, extend, go down, be gone, incline, intend, lay, let down, offer, outstretched, overthrown, pervert, pitch, prolong, put away, shew, spread (out), stretch (forth, out), take (aside), turn (aside, away), wrest, cause to yield.

H5188.definition: from 5197; a pendant for the ears (especially of pearls) chain, collar.

H5189.definition: from 5203; a tendril (as an offshoot) battlement, branch, plant.

H5190.definition: a primitive root; to lift; by implication, to impose bear, offer, take up.

H5191.definition: (Aramaic) corresponding to 5190; to raise take up.

H5193.definition: a primitive root; properly, to strike in, i.e. fix; specifically, to plant (literally or figuratively) fastened, plant(-er).

H5194.definition: from 5193; a plant; collectively, a plantation; abstractly, a planting plant.

H5196.definition: plural of 5194; Netaim, a place in Palestine plants.

H5197.definition: a primitive root; to ooze, i.e. distil gradually; by implication, to fall in drops; figuratively, to speak by inspiration drop(-ping), prophesy(-et).

H5198.definition: from 5197; a drop; specifically, an aromatic gum (probably stacte) drop, stacte.

H5199.definition: from 5197; distillation; Netophah, a place in Palestine Netophah.

H5200.definition: patronymic from 5199; a Netophathite, or inhabitant of Netophah Netophathite.

H5201.definition: a primitive root; to guard; figuratively, to cherish (anger) bear grudge, keep(-er), reserve.

H5203.definition: a primitive root; properly, to pound, i.e. smite; by implication (as if beating out, and thus expanding) to disperse; also, to thrust off, down, out or upon (inclusively, reject, let alone, permit, remit, etc.) cast off, drawn, let fall, forsake, join (battle), leave (off), lie still, loose, spread (self) abroad, stretch out, suffer.

H5204.definition: a doubtful word; apparently from 5091; lamentation wailing.

H5205.definition: from 5110; motion (of the lips in speech) moving.

H5206.definition: feminine of 5205; removal, i.e. exile removed.

H5207.definition: or נִיחֹחַ; from 5117; properly, restful, i.e. pleasant; abstractly, delight sweet (odour).

H5208.definition: (Aramaic) or נִיחֹחַ; (shorter) (Aramaic), corresponding to 5207; pleasure sweet odour (savour).

H5210.definition: of foreign origin; Nineveh, the capital of Assyria Nineveh.

H5212.definition: probably of foreign origin; Nisan, the first month of the Jewish sacred year Nisan.

H5214.definition: a root probably identical with that of 5216, through the idea of the gleam of a fresh furrow; to till the soil break up.

H5215.definition: or נִר; from 5214; properly, plowing, i.e. (concretely) freshly plowed land fallow ground, plowing, tillage.

H5216.definition: or נִר; also נֵיר; or נֵר; or (feminine) נֵרָה; from a primitive root (see 5214; 5135) properly, meaning to glisten; a lamp (i.e. the burner) or light (literally or figuratively) candle, lamp, light.

H5217.definition: a primitive root; to smite, i.e. drive away be viler.

H5218.definition: or נָכָא; from 5217; smitten, i.e. (figuratively) afflicted broken, stricken, wounded.

H5219.definition: from 5218; properly, a smiting, i.e. (concretely) an aromatic gum (perhaps styrax) (as powdered) spicery(-ces).

H5220.definition: from an unused root meaning to propagate; offspring nephew, son's son.

H5221.definition: a primitive root; to strike (lightly or severely, literally or figuratively) beat, cast forth, clap, give (wounds), × go forward, × indeed, kill, make (slaughter), murderer, punish, slaughter, slay(-er, -ing), smite(-r, -ing), strike, be stricken, (give) stripes, × surely, wound.

H5222.definition: from 5221; a smiter, i.e. (figuratively) traducer abject.

H5223.definition: smitten, i.e. (literally) maimed, or (figuratively) dejected contrite, lame.

H5224.definition: probably of Egyptian origin; Neko, an Egyptian king Necho. Compare 6549.

H5225.definition: from 3559; prepared; Nakon, probably an Israelite Nachon.

H5226.definition: from an unused root meaning to be straightforward; properly, the fore part; used adverbially, opposite before, over against.

H5227.definition: from the same as 5226; properly, the front part; used adverbially (especially with preposition), opposite, in front of, forward, in behalf of (over) against, before, direct(-ly), for, right (on).

H6198.definition: patronymically from 6197; an Eranite or descendant (collectively) of Eran Eranites.

H6199.definition: from 6209; naked, i.e. (figuratively) poor destitute. See also 6176.

H6205.definition: probably from 6201; gloom (as of a lowering sky) (gross, thick) dark (cloud, -ness).

H6209.definition: a primitive root; to bare; figuratively, to demolish make bare, break, raise up (perhaps by clerical error for raze), × utterly.

H6212.definition: from an unused root meaning to glisten (or be green); grass (or any tender shoot) grass, herb.

H6376.definition: from 6335; dispersive; Pishon, a river of Eden Pison.
